author: deepseek-v4.1-flash (opencode-go, operator session)
self_revisions: self-review: 'some text is present' is not 'the text we asked for' - OCR term coverage added and recorded as evidence
self-review: material cannot be proven from a PNG, so it is recorded and never blocks; claiming otherwise is the fabrication the gate exists to stop
self-review: an unreachable lane must fail closed rather than skip the axis, or every outage becomes a green run
self-review: a text-free brief with OCR unavailable must not block - the suppression lane is the control there, and the axis records unverified
self-review: the empty reply was diagnosed as a payload shape problem, not a model quality problem - think=false fixed it without changing the model

final_edit.shape: score five axes -> verdict -> write folder only when every blocking axis passes

probe_before: form match alone accepted a blank pack for a label brief and a render that drifted off the brief
probe_after: PASS/FAIL split live: text-free 3/3, label 4/4 with OCR reading LION MANE and 6 oz, and a later run of the same label brief blocked 3/4 on typography_illegible with no folder written
pattern: A gate that scores one axis reports success for every defect the other axes would have caught; score each axis separately, block on the ones that are verifiable, and record-but-never-block the ones that are not.
summary: Delivery now requires form, brief alignment, layout and typography - the last decided by OCR before the vision model opines.
